column1: # Breaks of the second gate text in plugin/commands/deliver.md. Run with:
# tests/mutate.sh --cmd 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx cucumber-js --tags @skills-text' tests/mutations/deliver-text.tsv
gate 2 drops the reuse sentence
gate 2 drops the blank line before the table
column3: s/then a blank line, then the table/then the table/

column1: gate 2 drops the designer's preferred fix
column3: s/Take the fix the designer prefers/Ask about it/

column1: developer note drops the second gate remarks
column3: s/and the technical remarks and fixes from the second gate//

column1: old second gate text back
column3: s/Design writes the scenarios, audits step reuse and lints the draft\./Design writes the scenarios, audits step reuse and lints the draft, and then shows the scenarios in plain words and waits for the go-ahead./

column1: gate 2 drops the label on each remark
column3: s/Put every other technical remark on its own line that starts "For the developer:"/Put every other technical remark under the table/

column1: gate 2 allows a list after the table
column3: s/one line each, never in a list after the table/in a list/

column1: gate 2 lets the go-ahead ride with the question
column3: s/Send that question alone, without the request for the go-ahead\./Ask it./

column1: gate 2 asks for the go-ahead in the same message
column3: s/ask for the go-ahead in a later message/ask for the go-ahead/

column1: step 5 allows a command of its own
column3: s/and not with a command you write yourself/or any command you write/

column1: step 5 asks the product manager to approve
column3: s/Never ask the product manager to approve a command\./Ask the product manager to approve a command./

column1: gate 2 names files in the plain text
column3: s/Name a file in plain words in the rest of the message/Name files as you like/

column1: gate 2 allows file names outside the developer lines
column3: s/Names of files and code go only on "For the developer" lines\./Names of files and code are fine./

column1: step 5 and the look-first message cite the command
column3: s/Say what you ran in plain words, such as "ran the real export", and put the command on a "For the developer:" line\./Say what you ran./g

column1: the Seen line keeps the command in the body
column3: s/The command goes on a "For the developer:" line/The command goes in the line/

column1: checklist lists an untouched scenario
column3: s/An existing scenario that nobody asked about is not an example: leave it out of the checklist\./An existing scenario is an example./

column1: checklist rule drops the Regression line
column3: s/The report counts it on the Regression line\. //

column1: checklist rule drops the covered example
column3: s/An agreed example that an existing scenario already covers stays an example\. //
